title: Ghostline
summary: Private pay-per-call channels for AI agents, with cumulative vouchers and one settlement. October 23 inspection ran all five browser-simulated calls: the interface displayed 50 µT accepted and then an explicitly separate archived Esmeralda receipt. Those clicks did not create a transaction. Release v0.4.0 also offers a Sapient test relay; it controls the test deposit and refund, so it is a custody experiment rather than a production payment service. The service sees requests and timing; privacy is not anonymity. No wallet, relay payment or CLI was run.
cardSummary: Explore payment channels that let AI agents pay per API call using cumulative vouchers and one settlement.
creator: AduAkorful

recording.credit: App demo — Five simulated calls and separate archived chain evidence; no wallet or payment.
